name: Audit and benchmark existing restoration checkpoints
hypothesis: Existing NAFNet or Full20 restorer checkpoints may provide higher PSNR/SSIM than V18 refiner baseline.

name: Proper paired evaluation of NAFNet F0 checkpoint
hypothesis: NAFNet trained on underwater degradation can surpass 25.48 dB PSNR on held-out scenes.

name: Restoration stage blending and sharpening grid
hypothesis: Optimal linear blending between physical model and neural refiner improves SSIM without sacrificing sharpness.

name: Train/finetune dedicated restorer on EURS 200-variant data
hypothesis: Supervised training on all 200 degradation variants per scene directly boosts PSNR towards 28+ dB.

name: Segmenter performance across restoration input variants
hypothesis: Evaluating segmenter on different restoration inputs (raw, physical, neural) reveals optimal coupling.

name: Evaluate existing DINOv2 Large checkpoints out-of-fold
hypothesis: DINOv2 Large feature backbone captures rare classes with higher boundary fidelity than SegFormer.

name: Fold-aware segmenter finetuning with rare-class protection
hypothesis: Balanced loss targeting Ray and MacroFauna scenes prevents absent-class collapse and boundary erosion.

name: End-to-end joint candidate validation and packaging
hypothesis: Best validated restorer + best validated segmenter achieves higher composite under official scorer.
